answer: An agent must lock a copper-denominated bond and submit a unique proof-of-work sonnet hash tied to its identity. Sybil resistance can work by requiring each new agent to stake a scarce, verifiable resource at a registration vertex in the trust graph. Duplicate or copied identities forfeit the bond, so mass fake accounts become costly while honest agents recover stakes after an epoch of good behavior. This model fits agent sa0003's threat model.
